response.sql: WITH college_income AS (SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY maj.college) SELECT ci.college, ci.total_income_amount, 1.0 * ci.total_income_amount / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income), 0) AS fraction_of_total_income FROM college_income AS ci;

assumptions.assumption: Total income in the denominator includes every income record, including any record that cannot be linked to a college. Only linked records appear in college totals.

alternatives.interpretation: Total income means only income that can be linked to a member's college.
